title: Sharing and access
intro: Manage workspace and page access with your current account.
sidebarNote: Nothing is published automatically. Invitees review the invitation with their verified email address before accepting.
singlePageOnly: This page only, excluding child pages.
memberScope: Join the workspace. Membership does not automatically grant access to private pages.
queuedNote: Creating an invitation saves a mail job. It does not confirm provider acceptance, delivery or receipt.
queued: Invitation instructions were queued. Delivery is not confirmed.
emptyInvitations: There are no invitations you can view.
noInvitePermission: You cannot invite people to this scope.
resendNote: Invalidate the old invitation link and queue new instructions.
revokeInviteNote: Invalidate an invitation link that has not been accepted.
membersPrivate: Member emails and the member list are visible only to workspace administrators.
removeMemberNote: Remove membership of this workspace. The last verified owner or last manager of a private page cannot be removed.
choosePage: Open this screen from a page's sharing control to manage that page's access.
noPagePermission: You cannot change access to this page.
manualAccountNote: Enter the ID of a verified account already in this workspace. Email addresses are not searched. Use an email invitation for someone new.
revokeAccessNote: Revoke this explicit page grant. Other valid grants, if any, still apply.
denyAccessNote: Deny this person's access to this page. A change that removes the last manager is not saved.
actorChanged: The signed-in account changed. Check your account and reopen this screen. Your input stays in this page's memory.
forbidden: This account cannot use these sharing settings. Check your account and current permissions.
conflict: Another action changed the state. Your input is retained. Reload, review and then submit again.
lastOwner: The last verified owner cannot be removed or demoted. Your input is retained; reload the current state.
lastManager: The last manager of a private page cannot be removed. Arrange an authorized handover first.
invalid: Check the input or the URL you opened. Your input is retained.
uncertain: The action result or connection could not be confirmed. Your input is retained. Reload and check the current state.
refreshFailed: The change was accepted, but the latest view could not be loaded. Reload to confirm the result.
reloaded: The current state was reloaded. Review the retained input before submitting.
preferencesFailed: Display preferences could not be saved on this device.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
resourceIntro: Set individual access to this page or collection. Manage workspace membership roles in settings.
descendantScopeNote: Child scope applies to records that inherit access. Inheritance boundaries and individual denials remain. Changes require management access to every descendant.
descendantGrantReview: Apply the selected individual permission to this page and record or child pages that inherit sharing.
revokeDescendantsNote: Revoke this individual grant, including its effect on record or child pages that inherit sharing.
copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Use the URL in the address bar.
webIntro: Publish only the reviewed body of this page to anyone with the link.
stopHint: The previous public link will no longer open this page. Content already saved or shared elsewhere cannot be withdrawn.
reviewReady: This is what will be published. Review the body and the exclusions.
literalSecrets: Personal data or secrets written directly in the body are not removed automatically. Review the whole preview.
exclude_structured-links: Internal, person and attachment link labels
consent: I confirmed this preview becomes visible to anyone with the link, without signing in.
publicWarning: Anyone with the link can read this body without signing in.
rotation: Each publication issues a new link and stops the previous one.
publicationUnavailable: Page publishing is not available on this server.
